artworks.title: Le Zendale (Woman in a Hood, or the Woman Returning from Church)
artworks.description: The image features a woman standing in three-quarters view, wearing a headscarf, long dress with a detailed hem, and a shawl. She is holding a small, slender object in her hands. In the background, there is an intricately designed building with a dome and pointed arches. A small dog is also present in the scene, and there is a statue and another building in the distance.

artworks.title: Le Zendale (Woman in a Hood, or the Woman Returning from Church)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing. She is facing slightly to the right with her head turned back towards the viewer. The woman's face is partially covered by a sheer veil, and her hair is hidden under a dark hood. She wears a long dress with multiple layers and a shawl over her head and shoulders. In her right hand, she holds a fan, and her left arm wraps a large scarf around her waist. A small dog stands at her feet. The background shows a large, domed building with two spires, and light clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Pietà
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a lifeless body on a fabric-covered surface. The drawing features intricate details, including flowing garments and facial expressions. In the background, light rays add drama, with figures near a structure resembling a cross. A crown of thorns lies on the ground in the foreground, and shading is used to create depth and emotion in the scene.

artworks.title: Reclining Nude
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in a reclining position, lying on their side with one arm extended to support their head. The other arm is bent near the torso. Facial features are not clearly outlined, and the head is depicted with dark scribbles for hair. The person is shown without clothing, and the body is outlined with flowing lines to depict a relaxed pose. There are no visible accessories or objects in the sketch. The background is a plain textured paper surface with no additional elements, focusing on the figure's contours and posture.

artworks.title: Marchesa Elena Grimaldi, Wife of Marchese Nicola Cattaneo
artworks.artist: Timothy Cole after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Eric Denker in honor of Arthur K. Wheelock, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with a relaxed posture, turned slightly to the side. She has fair skin, delicate facial features, and her hair is styled up, partially covered by an intricately patterned headpiece. She wears an elaborate dark dress with a ruffled collar and buttons down the front, holding a small bouquet of flowers. Beside her, there is another figure, a young person holding a large umbrella or parasol. The background includes grand, column-like structures, and a landscape with trees and a cloudy sky in the distance.

artworks.title: Francoys de Scepeaulx
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man shown from the waist up. The man is positioned in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. He has a strong face with a prominent nose, sharp cheekbones, and a full beard that contrasts with his shorter, refined facial hair. His hair is short and neatly styled. The man is wearing elaborate armor, decorated with intricate patterns, and a high collar that indicates a rank of significance. His pose is formal and stately. He is not holding any objects or visible jewelry. The background is a plain, neutral tone, focusing the attention on the detailed armor and the embellished coat of arms beneath his portrait. The border surrounding the image contains inscriptions that provide context to his identity, indicating that he is François de Scépeaux, Seigneur de Vieilleville, a Marshal of France.

artworks.title: January and February
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Paul Bril
artworks.description: This image shows an urban scene from an elevated vantage point. The horizon features hills with trees and silhouettes of buildings. In the central plane, there is a large obelisk surrounded by crowds of people. The architecture includes buildings with classical and medieval influences. In the foreground, various figures and animals are depicted near a rocky outcrop and a tree. The grayscale palette highlights textures and shades, creating a detailed visual effect. The image appears to be created using an engraving or etching technique, capturing both the busy city and serene countryside.

artworks.title: River Landscape with a Bridge; Monkey Paging through a Book
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper (2 subjects on one plate with remarques, proof)
artworks.description: The image depicts two separate scenes. The top section shows a figure with an open book, surrounded by dark, textured brushstrokes. The lower section shows a calm riverside landscape with a bridge, trees, tiny figures, and swirling clouds in the sky. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on black, white, and shades of gray. Ducks are visible in the water near the riverbank.

artworks.title: Das Schloss Prediama in Crein XII Stund: von Triest (Predjama Castle in Carniola, Twelve Hours from Trieste)
artworks.medium: lithograph on golden paper (on R.A. Winkler's original mat)
artworks.description: The image shows a grand castle built into a mountainside. The scene includes towering cliffs, forests, and the castle with multiple towers and walls. The castle is partially integrated into the rocky cliff face. The detailed artwork features fine lines, cross-hatching for texture, and a monochromatic sepia color palette. Buildings with sloped roofs stand among trees in the foreground, while the castle dominates the background with steep cliffs rising behind it.

artworks.title: La Vitrioleuse (The Acid Thrower)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing from the waist up in a side profile, with their head turned towards the viewer. The person has large eyes, a pale complexion, long auburn hair flowing over their shoulders, and is wearing a high-collared dark garment with frills. They are holding a bowl in their hands while the background has an abstract orange and cream design.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Barbara
artworks.description: There are three figures in the image. Two individuals are in an outdoor setting surrounded by grass. The central figure is kneeling with their hands together in front of them. They have long hair and are wearing a robe. To the left, a standing figure holds a sword and rests a hand on the kneeling person's head. The standing figure has long hair, a beard, and wears a robe. Above them, a winged figure holds a cloth. On the right, there is a stone tower with narrow windows and decorative roofing.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child in a Garden
artworks.medium: engraving in white on laid paper prepared with black ink
artworks.dimensions:
plate (diameter): 10.6 cm (4 3/16 in.)
sheet (diameter): 10.8 cm (4 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated individual, depicted in a classical or antique style, with their figure visible from the knees upward. The person is positioned in a seated pose, holding an infant child. The figure’s facial features appear serene, with wavy, flowing hair cascading down their shoulders. They wear a draping robe or gown, detailed with folds and textures. A crown is visible around their head. The background includes architectural elements and decorative foliage or plant life. The artwork is rendered in a monochromatic style, emphasizing form and composition.

artworks.title: A Poet Reading
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 13.3 x 9 cm (5 1/4 x 3 9/16 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 39.4 x 31.8 cm (15 1/2 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: Printed with fine black lines on cream-white paper, a man wearing a knee-length tunic and reading from a piece of unfolded paper faces our right against a mostly blank background in this vertical engraving. The man's right shoulder, closer to us, is angled in a way that suggests his torso is turned slightly away from us even though his feet and face are shown in profile. A narrow wreath is almost lost in his dense curls, and he has a straight nose and prominent chin. His fur-lined tunic is belted low across his hips, and a dagger hangs from his belt. His pointed clog-like shoes seem to slip onto his feet like sandals, and he stands on a grassy field in an otherwise empty space. Creases in the paper he holds suggests it had been folded into nine sections.

artworks.title: The Wissahickon Creek near Philadelphia
artworks.description: The image shows a stream surrounded by dense woods. A fallen tree trunk crosses the stream, with a man seated on a chair nearby. Trees frame the scene, and the overall color palette is earthy with browns and greens blending into the background.

artworks.title: Merchants' Exchange, Philadelphia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer
artworks.description: This is a neoclassical building with a dome and columns. The image shows a structure with a circular, colonnaded portico leading up to a dome, known as a rotunda, with a cupola on top. The building features rectangular windows between columns, likely Doric or Ionic. The architecture hints at a governmental building, possibly a bank or courthouse, exemplifying 19th-century neoclassical architecture. The photograph captures details such as stone steps leading up to entrances, the texture of the stone, and some furniture visible on the exterior. The sepia tones suggest an old photograph.

artworks.title: Park
artworks.medium: color lithographic facsimile on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Alexander Pope
artworks.description: The painting displays a stylized landscape with abstract tree-like shapes and blocks of color suggesting a receding land scene. Three prominent tree shapes rise upwards in the composition, placed somewhat centrally. The brushstrokes have a blocky, almost collage-like quality, using broad splashes of color and texture to form foliage and land. The color palette is rich and earthy, with various shades of green, dark browns, maroon, lighter greens, ochres, and muted red. The piece conveys a sense of layered textures and tones in nature without providing intricate details.

artworks.title: Peasant
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting on the ground, seen in profile with her full body visible. She is seated on a bundle of straw, with her knees bent and arms resting on them while holding an object. Her head is turned slightly downward, with her hair covered by a headscarf, leaving only part of her face visible. She is dressed in a long-sleeved shirt, a dark sleeveless dress or apron, a long skirt, and an apron over her lap. The background shows grass on the ground and dense foliage or vines against a wall, suggesting an outdoor setting. The image is in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Nude
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length view of a nude person standing on their toes against a wall. The person's arms are raised above their head, hands touching the wall, with their right knee slightly bent. Their head is tilted back slightly, with their face partially visible and displaying smooth facial features and a calm expression. The person has short hair falling softly around their head and is holding a piece of drapery that cascades behind them. The surroundings are slightly out of focus, with upholstery or drapery gathered on the floor to the right and a suggestion of furniture in the foreground. The background is a textured wall that fades into shadow towards the edges, adding to the composition's soft, atmospheric quality.

artworks.title: Hermann Struck in Uniform
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man in profile view from the waist up. The man has a mustache and darker hair, and is wearing a uniform with epaulets. The background is created with a wash of pale colors. The man is seated on a chair, and no specific objects or jewelry are visible.

artworks.title: Cheveaux des Ardennes
artworks.description: The image shows a man in military attire seated on a horse harnessed to a two-wheeled cart. The man is upright with a serious expression, wearing a military hat and a decorated coat. The cart is simple, and the horses are adorned with harnesses. The background is minimal, with the words "Chevaux Ardennois" inscribed below.

artworks.title: Cheval de Mecklembourg
artworks.description: This is an image of a horse in front of a stable. The horse is adorned with harnesses. In the background is a stable with large wooden doors and a small window above. The setting seems rustic, possibly on a farm or countryside stable. The scene is detailed, with attention given to the texture of the horse's coat and the brickwork of the stable. There is an aura of motion and interaction in the image.

artworks.title: Cheval de la plaine de Caen
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved depiction of a horse in profile view, standing with its head turned slightly to the left. A person is engaging with another individual. The horse is covered with a striped blanket. Two men are talking near an archway, dressed in period attire. One man wears a brimmed hat. In the background, two more figures are partially visible near an arch structure. The scene is set inside a stone-walled space, possibly a stable or courtyard, with shadows and textured surfaces adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: Horse Jumping a Barrier
artworks.description: The image shows a horse jumping over a fence. The horse is depicted in mid-air over a wooden gate or fence. The background is plain, with shading suggesting the ground and shadows. The lines and shadows are finely executed, emphasizing movement and strength. The drawing highlights the elegance and power of the horse in motion.

artworks.title: British Horse and Jockey
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a horse. The person is turned slightly to their left side, hand resting on the horse. The person's face is obscured by a helmet shadow. They wear typical equestrian attire. The horse has a decorative cloth on its saddle. The background is a minimalist landscape with a cloudy sky.
